title: One row of a table on its own screen, with its details, editing and related rows
about: A record's page (a client, a flat, a deck): opened with app.open('<slug>', {id}) or picked from a list here; shows its columns as labelled details, edits and deletes it, and lists rows of other tables that point to it.

key.about: names the pattern's data and state

title.about: a heading for the pick list, when no row is open

name.about: the column shown as the page's heading

show.about: the details shown, as table columns {"key", "label", "format"} (default: the fields)

list.about: the pick list's columns (default: the fields)

related.about: rows of other tables that point to this one: [{"table", "by" (their column holding this row's id), "title", "columns" (as in a table block, no expressions), "order"}]

back.about: the slug of the view the back button opens (default: back to the pick list)

data.{{key}}_recent: SELECT * FROM {{table}} ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 100

{{key}}_related.$value: =Promise.all({{related|json}}.map(r => (state.{{key}}_id || params.id) ? app.sql('SELECT * FROM ' + r.table + ' WHERE ' + r.by + ' = :id ORDER BY ' + (r.order || 'created DESC') + ' LIMIT 200', {id: state.{{key}}_id || params.id}) : []))

props.items: ={{show|json}}.map(c => { const v = {{key}}_row[c.key]; return {label: c.label || String(c.key).replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/^./, x => x.toUpperCase()), value: v == null || v === '' ? null : c.format === 'money' ? app.fmt.money(v) : c.format === 'date' ? app.fmt.date(v) : c.format === 'datetime' ? app.fmt.datetime(v) : c.format === 'bool' ? (v ? 'Yes' : 'No') : Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(', ') : String(v)}; })
